expected.reason: Plan of Work M2 makes typeText positive: cua returns successfully, inserts the marker exactly once and leaves gedit alive. The pinned x64 vendor engine still answers `editable Paste did not insert text`, inserts nothing and leaves gedit alive, the declared vendor defect named above.

Plan of Work M2 makes paste positive: cua returns successfully, inserts the marker exactly once and leaves gedit alive. The pinned x64 vendor engine still answers `editable Paste did not insert text`, inserts nothing and leaves gedit alive, the declared vendor defect named above. The two leading errors are the case's intentional html and md format-refusal probes, which the facade rejects before either engine is called.

#171 M4's T4 runs getAXState on a minimized window, the getAXState case's named variant (the plain case stays positive on both lanes): cua lists it with `minimized: true` (no other window carries the field), reads its full tree, answers its screenshot as unavailable, refuses input with `Window <id> is minimized; activate it first`, and activate_window restores it, after which the field is gone and the screenshot returns. The pinned x64 vendor engine leaves the minimized window out of list_windows, so every request answers `Window <id> is unavailable.`, the declared vendor defect named above.

vendorDefects.reason: On the #171 x86-64 VM the pinned vendor engine (sky_linux_x64, under cua's own host) leaves an iconified window out of list_windows, so once the bound gedit is minimized cua's policy and facade find it nowhere: getAXState, getScreenshot, pressKey and activate_window each answer `Window <id> is unavailable.` and the window stays minimized. The #171 design (Observation, Minimized windows; M4's T4) lists it with `minimized: true`, reads its tree and refuses its input as minimized, so this is recorded vendor behaviour, not passing coverage. The fixture's own second window took the focus (focusedFront true), as on the cua lane.

On the #171 x86-64 VM the pinned vendor engine (sky_linux_x64, under cua's own host, the only one Linux serves) answers typeText with `editable Paste did not insert text` after its 10 s EditableText.PasteText attempt; gedit (GTK 3) survives and the marker never reaches the text. Plan of Work M2's positive oracle requires success, exactly one marker and a surviving window, so this is recorded vendor behaviour, not passing coverage. This declaration names x64 only; arm64's distinct crash outcome will be measured and declared with M5's native-suite run.
